data.title: Full-Stack Software Developer, Energy Sector
data.summary: Develop and maintain web applications, backend services, APIs, system integrations, cloud environments, and automated deployment pipelines. Work in an international team to deliver reliable, scalable, secure, and well-tested solutions.

requirements.text: A few years of practical full-stack software development experience
Strong Node.js and/or TypeScript skills, plus Python, C#, or Java
Experience developing user interfaces with React
Experience with client-server architecture, backend APIs, and integrations
Basic knowledge of AWS or Azure, version control, CI/CD, and DevSecOps
Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field
Ability to use agent-based coding tools without compromising security
Ability to write clean, maintainable, well-tested code using best practices
Experience building and maintaining business-critical applications
Ability to pass a security clearance before starting
Strong problem-solving skills and interest in finding root causes
requirements.question: What does 'strong problem-solving skills' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for strong problem-solving skills and an interest in identifying root causes.
